t: Add support for disabling host prefix injection via the ``AWS_DISABLE_HOST_PREFIX_INJECTION`` environment variable or the ``disable_host_prefix_injection`` parameter in the shared aws configuration file.
Adds client context params support to ``Config``.
Configure the endpoint URL in the shared configuration file or via an environment variable for a specific AWS service or all AWS services.
Adding support for `defaults_mode` configuration. The `defaults_mode` will be used to determine how certain default configuration options are resolved in the SDK.
Added new configuration provider methods allowing for more flexibility in how a botocore session loads a particular configuration value.
